description: Tracked LTE bot-group settings used by the module release workflow.

signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.85 release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/min_tp_percent/risk_target_percent/strategy/entry_type/required_samples overrides. Market entries open immediately. Limit entries use the strategy price or two ticks beyond market when already crossed; an unfilled MRC limit entry is cancelled and rescheduled when its target is touched. MRC, movement, and SUG entry logic use the configured sample requirement. Stairs uses LevelExit; MRC Reclaim uses VirtualTrailingExit with favorable-only stop recalculation on each realtime evaluation and moves TP by 2 ticks from the current price after the virtual stop is crossed.
signal_actions.name: Start

params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.
params.name: Initial budget %

params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.
params.name: Trading amount %

params.description: Minimum structural TP distance. The larger of this value and the cascade average is used.
params.name: Minimum TP %

params.description: Optional target price-movement risk. When greater than 0, reduce the aggregate entry size when the projected stop-loss distance is wider than this percentage; 0 disables the adjustment.
params.name: Risk target %

params.description: Choose the existing Stairs strategy or MRC Reclaim. The selection takes effect on Start.
params.name: Strategy

params.description: Common sample requirement for MRC, movement, and SUG entry logic. Set to 0 to allow entry without learned samples; default 3.
params.name: Required samples

params.description: Market opens immediately. Limit uses the strategy solution or two ticks beyond market when already crossed. For MRC, an unfilled limit entry is cancelled and rescheduled when the target is touched.
params.name: Entry order
